wallpapers.name: Silk
wallpapers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed abstract screenshot backdrop wallpaper
Primary request: Sculptural flowing satin-like 3D waves, broad folded ribbons of periwinkle, ultramarine and pale lavender, a soft ice-blue crest sweeping diagonally across the lower third, deep indigo upper field. Volumetric soft studio light, silky matte material, serene premium macOS desktop wallpaper, restrained detail.
Composition: landscape 16:10, 2880 by 1800 pixels or larger, balanced edge-to-edge composition, no frames or borders, visual interest at edges while central area stays calm for a screenshot overlay.
Constraints: exceptionally polished smooth color transitions, no banding, no text, no logos, no people, no watermark. Deliver one finished wallpaper only.
